compos.text: Alt text: "Color desaturation may occur disproportionately to retention of acuity and form perception. The optic nerve is sensitive to red, so when it is damaged, red-colored objects may appear dull, washed-out or faded. Some patients who have optic neuropathy describe a red color as appearing orange or pink. This may indicate a problem with the optic nerve or the nerve tracts. This and any changes in Red Desaturation should be reported to your doctor."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is titled "Red Desaturation." It provides information about red desaturation, explaining that it can occur due to damage to the optic nerve, causing red-colored objects to appear dull, washed-out, or faded. It mentions that some patients with optic neuropathy may see red as orange or pink, indicating a potential problem with the optic nerve or nerve tracts, and advises reporting any changes to a doctor.

Below the informational text, there is a button labeled "Instructions" for further guidance. At the bottom of the screen, there is a button labeled "Unlock All Pro Tests and Remove Ads," suggesting an option to access additional features and remove advertisements by upgrading to a pro version.
